reasons.plausibility: The proposed load-partitioning and dislocation-locking mechanism at coherent phase boundaries is consistent with known strengthening concepts and aligns well with the dual-phase characteristics of FCC/BCC high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: A direct, controlled comparison between as-deposited and annealed coatings under identical creep conditions provides a clear test that could decisively confirm or refute the role of coherent interfaces.
reasons.usefulness: Understanding how interface coherency affects creep resistance offers a practical pathway to optimize coating microstructure and enhance high-temperature performance, making this hypothesis very beneficial to researchers.
